source_signals: agent-lab-package.zip: learning/ (routing, ledger, eval, runs/*/telemetry, regress), reports/ (20), agents, skills, scripts. learning/signals.json is stale (RUN-001..007 only), so most proposals cite file:line evidence instead of SIG ids.
ranking_method: rank = expected gain / effort (S=1, M=2, L=3). Gains are computed from package numbers where marked 'computed', otherwise labelled 'estimate'. Not the CAWL EV formula.
held_out_note: cm-01..03 have already been held-out cases for 3 roles / 4 bundles; prefer a fresh capability case (AL-10) where the eval_plan says so. Advice only: NEXUS tests locally and applies only on ACCEPT.

change.text: Add per case: tier ('capability' | 'regression'), uses (int, incremented by each gate), last_baseline (recall fraction), origin ('fixture' | 'incident' | 'field' | 'build'). Rules: a gate may only use capability cases with uses < 3; a case whose baseline >= 0.95 in a precheck (AL-02) moves to regression. Grow capability cases from prod-log incidents, blind-graded field snapshots and builds with hidden tests (RUN-029 hidden.test.mjs). Target mix: >= 1/3 non-audit. Owner labels ~10 extras per quarter to calibrate the blind grader (calibration only; not used to gate).

evidence: learning/eval-set.json:3-138 (11 cases: 10 audits/workspaces, 1 build, 0 production-write / trading / 3D)
learning/ledger.jsonl:9-15 (cm-01..03 used as held-out for solo, corax, dorn)

Anthropic, 'Demystifying evals for AI agents' (capability vs regression; graduate saturated evals; tasks from real failures)
proposals.root_cause: Held-out cases are reused until they become a dev set, saturated cases keep being gated, and the set does not resemble where tokens are spent.
proposals.expected_effect: Lower overfitting risk; gates measure the work NEXUS actually does. No token number claimed.
proposals.risk: Medium: authoring cost (Codex fixtures on the subscription).
proposals.eval_plan: regress list shows tier/uses; learn gate refuses a case with uses >= 3 (scripted check). After 4 weeks: share of gates on capability cases = 100%.
